chapter: Claude Hopkins, Fletcher Henderson and Fats Waller
title: Snowbound in New Hampshire; Fats's rhythm section
summary: Snow strands the bus; Mosley thinks Fats Waller's interest followed his stint with Fletcher.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: It was cold. We got up to New Hampshire and we got snow bound in the bus.
Clarence Holiday might have been in the band at that time, a guitar player; or Charlie Turner, Charlie Turner was a bass player.
Slick Jones might have been in the band.
I remember those guys, because I have a sneaky suspicion that that's how Fats happened to propose to me about coming with him.
I had just been with Fletcher.
You never worked for Sam Wooding; did you?
No, I never did. No, I never worked with Sam.
